svg.desc: 真实运行：Claude Haiku 4.5 用 Vestigium 读随附的样例（一份 10 页的 GAO 报告）. What staffing gap did GAO report for FEMA in May 2023, and what workforce reduction did it report in September 2025? search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA staffing gap May 2023") search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA workforce reduction September 2025") Staffing gap in May 2023: GAO reported in May 2023 that FEMA had an overall staffing gap of about 35 percent (6,200 staff) between the number of disaster employees on board and the agency's staffing goal across different positions in fiscal year 2022. (p. 6) Workforce reduction in September 2025: GAO reported in September 2025 that FEMA experienced workforce reductions of about 10 percent (about 2,450 staff) from January 1 through June 1, 2025, amid efforts from the Executive Branch to reduce the size of the federal workforce. (p. 7) Claude Haiku 4.5 · 8 秒 · $0.016
svg.text: Claude Code
问题
What staffing gap did GAO report for FEMA in May 2023, and what workforce reduction did it report in September 2025?
中文意思：GAO 在 2023 年 5 月报告的 FEMA 人手缺口是多少？2025 年 9 月报告的人员缩减又是多少？
工具调用（每次的第一条命中，有删节）
search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA staffing gap May 2023")
1. t111 · p6 · s6 What lessons have FEMA and disaster ser… | …For example, we reported in May 2023 that FEMA had
an overall staffing gap of about 35 percent (6,200 staff) between the number of disaster employees on board …
search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA workforce reduction September 2025")
1. t111 · p7 · s6 What lessons have FEMA and disaster ser… | …6 We reported in September 2025 that FEMA
experienced workforce reductions of about 10 percent (about 2,450 staff) from January 1 through June 1, 2025 …
答案（关键句，逐字照录）
Staffing gap in May 2023: GAO reported in May 2023 that FEMA had an overall staffing gap of about 35 percent (6,200
staff) between the number of disaster employees on board and the agency's staffing goal across different positions in
fiscal year 2022. (p. 6)
Workforce reduction in September 2025: GAO reported in September 2025 that FEMA experienced workforce reductions
of about 10 percent (about 2,450 staff) from January 1 through June 1, 2025, amid efforts from the Executive Branch to
reduce the size of the federal workforce. (p. 7)
意思是：2023 年 5 月的报告说，FEMA 的灾害人员和人手目标之间约有 35%（6,200 人）的缺口（第 6 页）；2025 年 9 月的报告说，2025 年 1
月 1 日到 6 月 1 日，FEMA 的人员减少了约 10%（约 2,450 人）（第 7 页）。
Claude Haiku 4.5 · 8 秒 · $0.016
